format.description: quote by default; disagreement only for a real disagreement

quote.description: Word for word from one speaker's consecutive transcript turns, 8-30 words, no surrounding quotation marks, no ellipsis; empty unless format is quote

context.description: One context sentence for quote; the whole post text for disagreement. No URL, hashtags or @-mentions

theme_hashtag.description: At most one theme hashtag including the #, never #DevSecOps; empty string for none
